summary: Taken together the five proposals cut the beta-based 10% stress loss from $21.93 to about $5.95. Invested exposure falls from 84.6% to about 60.7%: 39.3% cash, 6.5% TLT and 54.2% in ten single stocks. Consumer Staples (16.5% by bucket) becomes the largest sector exposure. All five orders use the day's full 5-trade allowance, and the VOO/VTI loss sales block a re-entry into US core through either fund until about 12-20. No lesson in learning.json names the Implicator, and no Implicator calls have been graded, so none shaped these checks. Bucket weights come from the packet's exposure block (bucket, not screen_label).

checks.concentration: Removes VOO at 13.19% of equity, the largest position. P1 and P2 together take the US broad equity ETF bucket from 23.1% to 0. Equity ETFs go to 0% of the asset mix. After all proposals the largest single position is DPZ at 11.93%, under the 15% cap.
checks.overlap: This reduces overlap. VOO's look-through holdings of large US names, including WMT, are no longer stacked on top of the single-stock book. The sale is paired with P2 because the two funds share one SPY 200-day stop (L9 grouping). Selling only one of them would leave the shared-stop exposure half-open.
checks.tax: FIFO sells all three lots: 0.084825 @ 707.22 (10-20), 0.021454 @ 698.69 (10-23) and 0.017091 @ 701.54 (10-26). At the 654.48 mark implied by market_value, these realize about -$4.47, -$0.95 and -$0.80, about -$6.23 in total, all short-term. long_term_on falls between 2027-10-21 and 2027-10-27, about 11 months away, so there is no reason to wait for long-term treatment.
checks.wash_sale: risk: the 10-26 lot falls inside the 30-day lookback, but the sale is a full exit, so no replacement shares remain and the loss is not disallowed. Going forward, a VOO rebuy before about 12-20 would wash the -$6.23 loss. That matters if SPY reclaims its 200-day within 30 days, because re-entry would then have to use another vehicle, not VOO or VTI.

The stress figure charges TLT only $1.78 per $100 in an equity drop, but its main loss scenario is rising yields, which the proposal itself names: a 10-year near 5.15% with hikes priced. The proposal quotes TLT at 9.7% volatility; I cannot verify that from my inputs.

IEF (loss sale 11-13) and BND (loss sale 11-16) are blocked, but TLT tracks a different index (20+ year Treasuries) and is not normally treated as substantially identical. That is a judgment call, so the PM should note it.
checks.summary: Acceptable size, and it adds only $0.71 of equity-stress loss. It does bring in rate risk the stress test cannot see, and it uses the fifth and last trade of the day.

notes: Stress arithmetic, using per-$100 figures times dollar amounts. Removed: VOO $80.74 x -9.95 = -8.03, VTI $60.71 x -10.07 = -6.11, FAST $30.51 x -5.29 = -1.61, EXEL $14.13 x -6.59 = -0.93, totalling +16.69 back. Added: TLT $40 x -1.78 = -0.71. Result: -21.93 + 16.69 - 0.71 = -5.95.

The -5.95 is flattered. It includes +$2.06 from KR (beta -0.57) and +$0.37 from SAM (beta -0.25), and both stored theses call those negative betas statistical artifacts, not hedges. Counting both at zero gives about -$8.38. IDXX (-$3.99) becomes the largest single stress contributor.

Sector after the trades, by bucket: Consumer Staples 16.5% (WMT 8.25, KR 5.87, SAM 2.40) becomes the largest exposure. Consumer Discretionary is 11.9% (DPZ only, which the SIC label calls Staples; by label the Staples stack is about 28.5%). Health Care is about 10.5%, Technology 5.95%, Communication 5.07% and Financials 4.21%; Industrials and US broad ETFs go to 0.
Trade budget: the five proposals use all 5 of trades_remaining_today, leaving no slot for a same-day stop-out (EXEL is the only position near its stop, and P4 sells it) or a correction.
Net realized P&L if all sells execute: about -$6.23 (VOO) - $4.26 (VTI) + $0.52 (FAST) - $0.86 (EXEL) = about -$10.83, all short-term.

Idle cash: about $240.7 (39.3%) after the trades. While the regime filter is off it can only go into BND, GLD, IEF or TLT, and BND and IEF are wash-sale blocked. When SPY reclaims its 200-day, VOO and VTI themselves are blocked until about 12-20, so US-core re-entry needs another vehicle (QQQ is on the list but carries a 1.45 beta) or must wait.
